title: Tribes: Vengeance (Revengeance community build)
note: Each build downloads this archive and extracts it on its own Mac (scripts/vengeance/prepare.py). Nothing from the game is stored in this repository; only paths and SHA-256 digests. The installer is unpacked with innoextract and never run.

archive.name: TribesVengeance.zip
archive.format: ZIP holding an Inno Setup 5.5.6 installer (setup.exe, setup-1.bin, setup-2.bin)
archive.rights: Community build of the 2004 game, which the publisher once offered as a free download; it includes the single-player content and the Engine.dll fix. The owner chose it as the engineering input (28 October 2026). Redistribution of the game or of translated binaries has not been established (docs/TRIBES-EXPANSION-RESEARCH.md).
